text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan sensed the immense pressure 
radiating from Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross, 
the two contending for the title of the 
"current" strongest, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Showing no signs of fear, she was instead 
thrilled at the prospect of experiencing 
that strength up close, courageously 
charging into the race.
